_note: Terminal markers (benches) for missions that need a checkable stopping point. Addressed explicitly via --cone-regions; never picked up by --cones, which would change what CONES=1 means. | Benches at 70, 65, 57 are DECISION landmarks for the depth-3 mission, not terminal markers. Each carries its own `type`, because a run can need a cone at one junction and a bench at another. | Every entry carries an explicit `type`. Without it the family map defaults to cone, so a bench region would silently answer the cone cue and never the bench one. | fountain1 at region 1 -- the J60-J63 BOTTOM EDGE of block [53,60,63,61], mid-edge on purpose. Approach J63 from r18 (south, OFF-block) so both block edges stay available: direct = LEFT at J63 (+90.5) onto the edge; detour = straight to J61 then LEFT at J61 (+90.3), J53 (+88.0), J60 (+91.5), arriving on the same edge from the far end. Three real 90 deg turns. A CORNER destination would be reachable only by the blocked move, and J61 is a straight-through (+1.5) on the east block, so neither works as a siting.
